expression_overall_survival.note: Exploratory median split among patients with primary expression

analysis_definitions.alteration: COAD BRAF uses p.V640E (canonical V600E transcript equivalent); BRCA ERBB2 and GBM EGFR use nonsynonymous coding mutations excluding synonymous, splice and truncating annotations
analysis_definitions.expression: Gene-level HiSeqV2 expression; primary tumour sample when available
analysis_definitions.survival: Dead=event; living patients use latest follow-up

limitations: Observational TCGA data; survival models are unadjusted
Altered-group definitions are exploratory except the COAD BRAF V600E hotspot
Aggregate output only; no patient-level records
